display_name: 六种条件后验的源监督切换效用网络
description: 固定盲信道及类别条件后验，训练输入证据效用网络辨别切换修复与损伤，并用配对源波形误差保护。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], six frozen class-conditional posterior waveform hypotheses; candidate F feature/probability, predicted noise and forward residual
data.tx_sets_ref: Only L_s fit labels enter training; U_s uses high-confidence frozen clean F pseudo labels, no U_s truth, V or test

permissions.query_use: Only source fit L_s truth and U_s high-confidence clean F pseudo targets; no U_s truth/V/test
permissions.claim_scope: Source source IDs used by F and seen in other channel views, pseudo targets not independent test; bounded correction may exploit classifier

checkpoint.initialization: Random pairwise utility MLP; fixed blind source model, six class source priors and frozen F. DURA comparison after training only.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Blind action SHA256 0ef60a205f785bda45f9936d519e925179dbbddeef2fd6cd285a83b02a284338 and source prior SHA256 5e35516d54d3e3d1d1749933861f290c1f87c8ffdb4b863d2f9819914135ceb9
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed 4096 source fit IDs, views21/22/23; minimum 100 source pairs with >=10 positives and negatives, 10 MLP epochs, final weight; source RX8 diagnostic thresholds .5/.75/.9. No target selection or automatic test.

metric_names: source pair positive and negative counts
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source fit L_s truth or U_s pseudo targets; positive repair also requires paired source IQ error <=1.2x parent; no target labels at inference.

rows.method: input-only pairwise utility selector over six fixed class-conditional posterior IQ waveforms
rows.purpose: learn when switching conditional IQ hypothesis repairs vs harms parent while protecting source waveform
rows.seed_notes: 4096 source fit IDs disjoint from 8192 prior IDs, source fit/order seed 2026121355, MLP seed 2026121356
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Only L_s fit-ID truth, U_s high-confidence clean-F pseudo labels; no U_s truth, V or target.
Training positive repair requires paired source IQ error <=1.2*parent; model never sees clean IQ at inference.
At least 100 source pairs with both >=10 positive and negative required before training.
Class conditional hypotheses can hallucinate identity; source sample explored and pseudo target is not true test accuracy.
